nuggets.text: Rockets coach Mike Jacobs was an offensive lineman and long snapper at Ohio State and played in two Sugar Bowls.
Andrew Zock won the 2025 Buck Buchanan Award as the best defensive player in FCS at Mercer before joining the Rockets.
Before starring at defensive end, Andrew Zock was a high school linebacker who first committed to Navy.
Connor Walendzak broke a 71-yard touchdown run at Michigan State that gave the Rockets the lead.
Adjatay Dabbs caught two touchdowns at Michigan State, including a 60-yarder from John Alan Richter.
The Glass Bowl got its name in 1946 after a renovation added glass elements, a nod to Toledo's glass industry.
A real Army Nike Ajax missile, acquired by the university in 1961, stands on a 14-foot pylon outside the Glass Bowl.
Chuck Ealey led the Rockets to 35 straight wins from 1969 to 1971, the most by an FBS quarterback without a loss.
The Rockets nickname came from two long touchdown runs in a 1923 loss to Carnegie Tech.
Maumee, Ohio native Mike Jacobs brought a 94-23 record to the Rockets and has never had a losing season as a head coach.
